# Why this section exists

Using a model inside a real program is a different skill from explaining how the model works. This section is for that developer view: calling a model, giving it context, checking what came back, and keeping the rest of the application honest.

# What will live here

Pages I intend to write, not pages that exist today:

- Calling a model from code (APIs, not magic).
- Prompting as a specification, and where it stops being enough.
- Structured output, tools, and failure modes.
- How this section will point at [RAG and agents](/rag/rag-index.qmd) and at [MLOps](/mlops/mlops-index.qmd) without duplicating them.

Nothing above is written yet.
